content_zh:
“本帝给你两个选择。一，成为本帝的修炼鼎炉，二……”
一个混沌空间内，一名绝色美女凌空而立，居高临下望着一名棱角分明的少年。
此女身材婀娜、肤白如雪，长着一张倾国倾城的脸，胸前的巨峰呼之欲出，让人挪不开眼睛。
她的身上散发着上位者的气息，冰冷、高贵，但看向少年的眼神却炙热无比，如同看着饿狼看着美味佳肴一般。
这名绝色美女名为混沌女帝，乃是屹立于修士之巅的无上存在，活了无尽岁月。
而少年名叫楚凌天，则是九州大陆，一个偏远帝国的豪族子弟，年仅十六岁。
“二！二！我选二！”
楚凌天想都没想，急切地喊道。
他已经被混沌女帝采阴补阳了一次，感觉腰都快断了。若是成为混沌女帝的修炼鼎炉，下场必定会凄惨无比。
混沌女帝道：“二，成为本帝的道侣！拼命修炼，百年之内，问鼎修士之巅。否则，死！”
混沌女帝的话，让楚凌天浑身一颤，眼中露出绝望之色，这一和二基本没有区别啊。
俗话说得好，女大三抱金砖，女大三千位列仙班。
可混沌女帝大他9999万岁，不仅没给他好处，反而还想要他的命！
“既然你已做出了选择，那便为本帝继续疗伤吧！”
楚凌天闻言，双眼一闭。
他的身体早已被混沌女帝定住，只能任由她折腾。
只见混沌女帝身形一闪，瞬间来到楚凌天面前，将他扑倒……
混沌女帝修为极高，弹指便可碾碎山河、破碎虚空。
楚凌天所在的九州大陆，对她而言，不过是弱小的下界大陆罢了。
即便是九州大陆最强的修士，也敌不过她的随手一指。

但她在打破桎梏，即将突破无上之境时，突然遭到好友九天女帝的背叛，将她重创，欲要夺取她从上古遗迹中获得的至宝“混沌宝塔”。
混沌女帝拼死搏杀，付出巨大代价，施展出禁术，用混沌宝塔击碎空间，逃到下界。
虽然保住了性命，但她不仅身受重伤，还中了九天女帝的狐媚之毒。若是不能立刻找到一名处男，阴阳交合，用其元阳压制体内的狐媚之毒。用不了多久，她就会身死道消。
一天一夜后，楚凌天缓缓睁开双眸，顿时感到一股虚弱袭来。
他扶着腰，缓缓坐起身，就看到混沌女帝盘坐在一旁，双手结印，正在修炼。
经过一天一夜的滋润，混沌女帝的脸色明显红润了许多，气息也变得愈发强大。
“我不是选择了二吗？怎么待遇和修炼鼎炉一样。”楚凌天心生绝望。
就在他胡思乱想之时，混沌女帝蓦然睁开双眸，明亮的双眸让星辰都为之黯淡。
楚凌天都有些看呆了。
“看够了没有？”
一道冷漠的声音，将楚凌天拉回现实。
“虽然本帝采了你的元阳，但你也不亏。你受损的根基已经恢复。”混沌女帝开口道。
听到混沌女帝的话，楚凌天双拳猛地紧握，眼中涌出滔天杀意，咬牙低吼道：“楚家！不报此仇，我誓不为人！”
content_en:
"This emperor gives you two choices. One, become my cultivation cauldron, and two..."
In a chaotic space, a stunning beauty stood in the sky, looking down at an angular young man.
This woman has a graceful figure, skin as white as snow, and a face that is stunning to the world. The giant peaks on her chest are about to appear, making people unable to take their eyes away.
She exuded the aura of a superior person, cold and noble, but the eyes she looked at the boy were extremely hot, like looking at a hungry wolf looking at delicious food.
This stunning beauty is called the Empress of Chaos. She is a supreme being who stands on the top of the monks and has lived for endless years.
The boy's name is Chu Lingtian, a son of a wealthy family in a remote empire in the Jiuzhou Continent. He is only sixteen years old.
"Two! Two! I choose two!"
Chu Lingtian shouted eagerly without even thinking about it.
He had already been sucked out and replenished by the Empress of Chaos once, and it felt like his waist was about to break. If he becomes the training cauldron of the Chaos Empress, his end will definitely be miserable.
The Empress of Chaos said: "Two, become my Taoist companion! Practice hard and strive to be the top monk within a hundred years. Otherwise, die!"
The Empress of Chaos' words made Chu Lingtian tremble all over, and there was a look of despair in his eyes. There was basically no difference between the first one and the second one.
As the saying goes, female juniors hold gold bricks, and female juniors rank among the immortals.
But the Empress of Chaos was 99.99 million years older than him. Not only did she not give him any benefits, she actually wanted his life!
"Now that you have made your choice, continue to heal the emperor!"
When Chu Lingtian heard this, he closed his eyes.
His body had already been immobilized by the Empress of Chaos, and he could only let her do what she wanted.
The Empress of Chaos flashed in front of Chu Lingtian and threw him down...
The Empress of Chaos has an extremely high level of cultivation and can crush mountains and rivers and shatter the void with just a snap of her fingers.
To her, the Jiuzhou Continent where Chu Lingtian was located was just a weak lower realm continent.
Even the strongest monk in Jiuzhou Continent is no match for her casual finger.
But when she broke through the shackles and was about to break through to the supreme realm, she was suddenly betrayed by her friend, the Empress of the Nine Heavens, who severely wounded her in an attempt to seize the treasure "Chaos Pagoda" she obtained from the ancient ruins.
The Empress of Chaos fought desperately, paid a huge price, cast forbidden spells, shattered the space with the Chaos Pagoda, and escaped to the lower world.
Although she saved her life, she was not only seriously injured, but also poisoned by the Empress of the Nine Heavens. If a virgin cannot be found immediately, the yin and yang can be combined and the yin and yang can be used to suppress the poison of foxiness in the body. It won't be long before she dies.
One day and one night later, Chu Lingtian slowly opened his eyes and suddenly felt a wave of weakness coming over him.
He held his waist and slowly sat up, and saw the Empress of Chaos sitting cross-legged beside her, forming a seal with her hands and practicing.
After a day and night of moisturizing, the Empress of Chaos's face was obviously much rosier, and her aura became more powerful.
"Didn't I choose No. 2? The treatment is the same as that of cultivating a cauldron." Chu Lingtian felt desperate.
Just as he was thinking wildly, the Empress of Chaos suddenly opened her eyes, her bright eyes dimming the stars.
Chu Lingtian was dumbfounded.
"Have you seen enough?"
A cold voice brought Chu Lingtian back to reality.
"Although I have harvested your Yuanyang, you are not at a loss. Your damaged foundation has been restored." The Empress of Chaos said.
Hearing the words of the Empress of Chaos, Chu Lingtian clenched his fists fiercely, his eyes filled with murderous intent, and he gritted his teeth and roared: "Chu family! If I don't avenge this, I swear I won't be a human being!"
